metadata.description: Indian government scholarship, fellowship and student financial assistance scheme directory with eligibility, funding, application, documentation and verification fields.
metadata.verificationPolicy: Verify the current academic-year guidelines, application window, eligibility, funding limits, participating institutions and official application route before publishing a scheme as open or confirming an award.
metadata.priorityPolicy: priority is a directory display order only and does not represent award value, selection probability or eligibility.
notes: A listed scheme is not a guarantee of eligibility or funding.
A null amount means the current applicable amount has not been confirmed for this record.
Distinguish fresh applications from renewals and distinguish application deadlines from verification deadlines.
Income limits, category certificates, course restrictions and institution requirements must be checked against the applicable scheme guidelines.
Documents listed are commonly relevant preparation items and are not a substitute for the official document checklist.
Fellowships and scholarships are both included but should be identified by fundingType.
Verify whether a scheme is available for the selected academic year before displaying an application button.
Do not use an old application deadline as the current deadline.
Only use verified application URLs; official information pages and application portals may be different.

records.name: PM-USP Central Sector Scheme of Scholarship for College and University Students
records.administeringAuthority: Department of Higher Education, Ministry of Education
eligibleCourses: eligible regular college and university programmes; verify current guidelines
records.eligibilitySummary: Selection is based on Class XII academic performance and other scheme-specific conditions. Confirm board, merit, income, regular-study and institutional requirements in the current guidelines.
records.awardStructure: Scheme-defined scholarship assistance; confirm current rate, duration and renewal conditions.
records.deadlineScope: Renewal applications as displayed on NSP; verify fresh-application dates separately.

engineering
professional programmes; verify exclusions and current guidelines
records.eligibilitySummary: Check domicile, Class XII qualification, family income, admission route, institution eligibility and excluded courses in the current scheme guidelines.

records.name: Ishan Uday Special Scholarship Scheme for North Eastern Region
eligibleCourses: eligible regular full-time undergraduate degree programmes
records.eligibilitySummary: UGC scheme information specifies Class XII qualification from a school in the North Eastern Region, first-year regular full-time undergraduate admission and parental income below INR 450000 per year. Confirm current rules and exclusions.
records.awardStructure: UGC scheme information lists INR 80000 per annum. Confirm current academic-year rate, duration, allocation and eligible programme rules before publication.
requiredDocuments: North Eastern Region domicile or residence evidence as prescribed
